name: Ashton Hayes
title: Mental Health Social Worker
description: Ashton is a trauma-informed therapist and works collaboratively with clients to create a safe, respectful, and supportive therapeutic space. Ashton draws on a range of evidence-based therapeutic approaches, including EMDR and other trauma-focused interventions. In addition to trauma work, Ashton supports women navigating significant life stage transitions, including perimenopause and menopause, recognising the emotional, relational, and identity changes that can arise during these times. Areas of practice: Trauma, Depression, Anxiety, Panic attacks, Stress reduction, Womens health.
specialties: EMDR, Trauma, Depression, Anxiety, Panic attacks, Stress reduction, Womens health

name: Alice Morgan
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Dr Alice Morgan is a Clinical Psychologist with 20 years' experience in EMDR therapy. She is currently a Consultant in Training and works with EMDR Academy to help facilitate training in EMDR for clinicians. She has experience in working with all types of complex trauma presentations, including developmental trauma, refugee trauma, medical trauma etc. Alice is adept at adjusting EMDR to meet the individual's needs and can work with a variety of presentations. name: Amy Brandler
title: Forensic Psychologist
description: I am an EMDRAA™ Accredited Consultant and a Clinical and Forensic Psychologist. I enjoy supporting EMDR practitioners to build confidence in using EMDR with complex and high-risk presentations, including forensic clients. I have worked across custodial and community settings, including prisons and private practice, and bring broad experience using EMDR with adolescents and adults experiencing complex trauma, anxiety, personality disorders, and offending behaviours.
